title: Two-Way Branching with if and else
description: Add an else block to an if(age >= 35) check so the program executes one of two mutually exclusive branches.

steps.description: Set int age = 38 and check if(age >= 35) on line 5 to print the eligible message on line 6.
Attach an else block on lines 7-9 that prints 'You're too young to run for President.' whenever age >= 35 is false.

steps.question: Can both line 6 and line 8 execute during the same run of main?
steps.answer: No; age >= 35 is either true or false, so Java runs line 6 when age >= 35 is true (as with age = 38) and skips the else block.

steps.description: Notice how execution jumps from line 6 straight to line 10 at the end of main, skipping line 8 inside the else block.
